pass_title: Pass Orchestrator v1.5 End-to-End Acceptance Test
goal: Exercise the Pass Orchestrator v1.5 workflow end-to-end with three small, harmless, documentation-only sub-passes that describe the orchestrator itself, provide an operational checklist, and summarize the resulting end-to-end run, without touching any application code.
global_constraints: Only add or edit the three declared Markdown files under docs/.
Never touch the main branch; all work happens on pass_branch only.
Never commit unrelated or accidental files (build output, .vs/, bin/, obj/).

sub_passes.title: Add orchestrator v1.5 overview doc
sub_passes.objective: Create docs/orchestrator-v1-5-overview.md briefly explaining what Pass Orchestrator v1.5 is.
acceptance_criteria: It briefly explains what Pass Orchestrator v1.5 is.
It mentions pass plans, isolated pass/* branches, checkpoint commits, validation gates, BLOCKED_CRITICAL, READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW, and human-only merge.

sub_passes.title: Add orchestrator v1.5 operational checklist
sub_passes.objective: Create docs/orchestrator-v1-5-checklist.md with a concise operational checklist for starting, executing, validating, reviewing, and merging a pass, making clear that main is never modified by the orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: It provides a concise operational checklist covering starting, executing, validating, reviewing, and merging a pass.
It explicitly states that main is never modified by the orchestrator.

sub_passes.title: Summarize orchestrator v1.5 end-to-end result
sub_passes.objective: Create docs/orchestrator-v1-5-e2e-result.md summarizing what sub-passes .1 and .2 produced, referencing the pass plan file pass-plans/orchestrator-v1-5-e2e.json, and stating that this file is the final E2E artifact.
acceptance_criteria: It summarizes what sub-passes orchestrator-v1-5-e2e.1 and orchestrator-v1-5-e2e.2 produced.
It references/links the pass plan file pass-plans/orchestrator-v1-5-e2e.json.
It states that this file is the final E2E artifact.

requirements: Exactly three checkpoint commits exist on pass_branch beyond base_branch, one per sub-pass, in order.
The cumulative diff from base_branch to HEAD touches only: docs/orchestrator-v1-5-overview.md, docs/orchestrator-v1-5-checklist.md, docs/orchestrator-v1-5-e2e-result.md.
StudentPlannerApp/**, StudentPlannerApp.sln, and .github/workflows/** are byte-for-byte unchanged versus base_branch.
main was never checked out for writes and was never pushed to.
No force-push occurred at any point.
